note: What a server sends to restate how many of an effect are stacked on several units at once. The header names no object it acts on: the units are listed below.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long the effect has left to run, in seconds: a client takes it as the timeLeft of an EffectCount.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How long it has already run, in seconds.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many units follow.

fields.name: entries
unit
fields.note: The unit carrying the effect.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: The unit that put it there.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's effect slots it sits in.

fields.name: stacks
fields.note: How many are stacked there now.
The units, one place each.
